name: server.test
title: Layered probe of one Server
summary: Deliberately not one latency number. A TCP connect succeeding says nothing about whether the VLESS handshake works or whether traffic actually egresses the VPS, so results are reported per layer and a TCP-only pass is never labelled 'proxy OK' (master prompt 13).

layers.description: Ordered by the Connector, not by the caller: dns before tcp before core-outbound before proxied-http.

egressProbe.description: When true, fetch the configured egress endpoint through the Core and return the observed public IP. This is the only layer that can prove the tunnel is carrying traffic.

overall.description: 'partial' = lower layers passed, a higher layer did not. 'not-proxied' = something answered but the egress IP was not the expected one, i.e. traffic leaked. The two are different user-visible facts.

egressIp.description: Only present when egressProbe was requested and proxied-http passed.

invariants: Results are never replayed from the idempotency cache: replayable=false, and a client that receives a cached response must mark it stale (ADR-0008).
server.test is rate-limited per serverId so a UI defect cannot launch a probe storm against the VPS (docs/architecture/31).
